content.description: When there is a negative connection between the 1st (self), 2nd (wealth/speech), 6th (dispute/litigation) and 7th (opposition) houses, disputes reach the court.

key_yogas.name: Lagna-6th Lord Relation
key_yogas.details: Lagna Lord in the 6th house or 6th Lord in the Lagna creates repeated legal troubles in life.

key_yogas.name: Exchange of Houses
key_yogas.details: Lagna Lord in the 6th house and 6th Lord in the Lagna indicates the person is surrounded by litigations throughout life.

key_yogas.name: Malefic Influence
key_yogas.details: If both Lagna and Lagna Lord are under malefic influence (Saturn, Mars, Rahu) and the 6th Lord is strong.

content.example: In Aries Lagna, if Lagna Lord Mars is in the 6th house and 6th Lord Mercury is in the Lagna, along with Rahu's aspect on the Lagna, such a native is constantly entangled in legal disputes.

content.description: The 6th house is the primary indicator of the origin of disputes, the strength of the enemy, and court cases.

key_points.name: Comparative Strength
key_points.details: If Lagna Lord is stronger than 6th Lord: Native completely dominates the enemy in the legal process. If 6th Lord is stronger than Lagna Lord: Opposing party maintains mental and legal pressure on the native.

key_points.name: Position of Planets
key_points.details: Benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus) in the 6th house try to pacify the enemy but can weaken the native's legal side. Natural malefic planets (Saturn, Mars, Sun, Rahu) in the 6th house form 'Shatruhanta Yoga' (Enemy Destroyer Yoga).

content.example: In Leo Lagna, if the 6th Lord Saturn sits in the 10th house (Taurus) with Digbala and the Lagna Lord Sun is weak in the 12th house (Cancer), the opposing party will consistently prove stronger in court.

content.description: The 8th house signifies sudden crisis, secret conspiracies, defamation, fraud (Section 420), or serious criminal cases.

key_points.name: Depth of Dispute
key_points.details: While the 6th house causes quarrels, how deep, humiliating, and stressful the quarrel will be is determined by the 8th house.

key_points.name: Reputation Damage
key_points.details: The connection of the 8th Lord with the 6th or 10th house causes a stain on the native's reputation through a court case.

content.example: In Taurus Lagna, if the 8th Lord Jupiter is afflicted in the 10th house (Aquarius) and the 6th Lord Venus goes to the 8th house, a case of fraud or defamation is suddenly registered against the native in their workplace.

content.description: The 12th house represents immense court expenses, fines, financial loss, and jail/solitary confinement.

key_points.name: Yoga for Financial Ruin
key_points.details: If the 2nd Lord (wealth) or 11th Lord (gains) establishes a relationship with the 12th and 6th houses, the native's wealth is exhausted in lawyer fees and legal procedures.

content.example: In Gemini Lagna, if the 2nd Lord Moon is in the 12th house (Taurus) and aspected by the 6th Lord Mars, the native drowns in heavy debt in the process of winning the case.

content.description: The planet causing the dispute reveals the source or relationship of the enemy.

key_points.name: Afflicted Sun
key_points.details: Case from government department, tax authority, or father-figure.

key_points.name: Afflicted Mars
key_points.details: Case from brother, relatives, partner, or related to real estate/property.

key_points.name: Afflicted Mercury
key_points.details: Business partner disputes, cheque bounce, or document fraud.

key_points.name: Afflicted Venus
key_points.details: Marital dispute, divorce, alimony, or a case from the female side.

content.example: In Libra Lagna, if the 7th Lord and 2nd Lord Mars are afflicted along with Venus in the 6th house (Pisces), a court case is formed between husband and wife regarding property and divorce.

content.description: The nodes bring unexpected twists to legal matters.

key_points.name: Rahu's Influence
key_points.details: Rahu causes false witnesses, fake evidence, cybercrime, forgery, and sudden police cases. If in the 6th or 8th house, unexpected twists occur.

key_points.name: Ketu's Influence
key_points.details: Ketu shows sudden detachment from the case, mental confusion, bad advice from lawyers, and the case closing without any concrete result.

content.example: In Cancer Lagna, if Rahu is in the 6th house (Sagittarius), the opposition tries to entangle the case by presenting false evidence in court.

content.description: Mars is the main significator of land, blood, aggression, and police/administration.

key_points.name: Positive Mars
key_points.details: If Mars is in its own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exalted (Capricorn) in the 6th house, the native fights fearlessly and defeats the enemy.

key_points.name: Negative Mars
key_points.details: If Mars is debilitated (Cancer) and afflicted in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, the native gets trapped due to their own anger or illegal steps.

content.example: In Capricorn Lagna, if Mars (lord of 4th house - Aries) sits exalted in the Lagna (Capricorn), the native has a one-sided victory in every land dispute court case.

content.description: Analyzing when court cases start and when verdicts are delivered.

key_points.name: Start of Court Case
key_points.details: When Mahadasha or Antardasha of the 6th Lord, 8th Lord, or malefic planets sitting in these houses starts. Also when the Antardasha of the 6th Lord runs during the Mahadasha of the Lagna Lord.

key_points.name: Transit Indications
key_points.details: Transit of Saturn or Rahu over the 6th house, 8th house, or Lagna, while simultaneously aspecting the natal 6th Lord.

content.example: In Virgo Lagna, when the transit of 6th Lord Saturn is from the 8th house (Aries) and the Antardasha of Saturn is running, the first notice or FIR is received.

content.description: Factors causing litigations to stretch for years.

key_yogas.name: Saturn's Aspect
key_yogas.details: Aspect of Saturn on the 6th house, 6th Lord, or 8th house.

key_yogas.name: Retrograde Planets
key_yogas.details: 6th Lord or 8th Lord being retrograde leads to the case repeatedly re-opening or going into appeal.

key_yogas.name: Fixed Signs
key_yogas.details: 6th Lord sitting in fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) causes the matter to stay stuck in one place for years.

content.example: If retrograde Saturn is sitting in the 6th house, the case drags on for 15-20 years due to the absence of witnesses or changing of judges.

content.description: Conditions favoring the native in court.

key_yogas.name: Strong Lagna Lord
key_yogas.details: Lagna Lord being significantly stronger than the 6th Lord and 7th Lord in Shadbala.

key_yogas.name: Cruel Planet in 6th
key_yogas.details: Cruel planet (Sun/Mars/Rahu) giving Upachaya house results in the 6th house.

key_yogas.name: 11th Lord Support
key_yogas.details: 11th Lord in an auspicious position in Kendra or Trikona and casting an aspect on the 6th house.

content.example: In Sagittarius Lagna, if the Lagna Lord Jupiter is forming Hamsa Yoga in the Lagna and exalted Sun is sitting in the 6th house, the final verdict will come in favor of the native.

key_yogas.name: Weak Lagna Lord
key_yogas.details: Lagna Lord being debilitated, combust, or in Paapakartari in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house.

key_yogas.name: Strong 6th Lord
key_yogas.details: 6th Lord having full control over the 10th house (Judge/Court) or 11th house (Gains).

key_yogas.name: 10th Lord Subordinate
key_yogas.details: 10th Lord becoming subordinate to the 6th house (attitude of court favoring the opponent).

content.example: In Cancer Lagna, if the Lagna Lord Moon is with Rahu (Grahan Yoga) in the 8th house and the 6th Lord Jupiter is exalted in the 10th house, one has to face defeat.

key_yogas.name: Benefic Influence
key_yogas.details: Influence of Jupiter or Venus on the 6th and 7th houses.

key_yogas.name: Friendly Lords
key_yogas.details: Temporary friendship or auspicious conjunction between the 6th Lord and Lagna Lord.

key_yogas.name: Role of Mercury
key_yogas.details: Connection of Mercury (significator of conversation/mediation) with the 6th or 7th house.

content.example: If Jupiter is in the 6th house and exalted Venus is in the 7th house, both parties resolve the dispute through mutual agreement sitting outside the court.

content.description: Bandhan Yoga indicating imprisonment or judicial custody.

key_yogas.name: Affliction of Lords
key_yogas.details: Lagna Lord and 12th Lord afflicted together by Saturn/Rahu in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house.

key_yogas.name: Paapakartari Yoga
key_yogas.details: Malefic planets sitting on both sides of the Lagna and 12th house.

key_yogas.name: Afflicted Sun
key_yogas.details: Sun (Law/Government) severely afflicted by Rahu or Saturn while the 12th Lord is strong.

content.example: In Scorpio Lagna, if the Lagna Lord Mars is with Saturn and Rahu in the 12th house (Libra) and the 12th Lord Venus is debilitated in the 6th house, the native faces jail sentence.

content.category: Timing of Final Decision from Dasha & Transit
content.description: A three-tier coordination of Mahadasha, Antardasha, Pratyantar Dasha, and Transit determines the verdict timing.

key_points.name: Initiation
key_points.details: Running Mahadasha or Antardasha of the 6th or 8th Lord combined with Pratyantar of a malefic in the 6th house triggers litigations. Intensified if transiting Saturn or Rahu passes over the 6th, 8th, or Lagna Lord.

key_points.name: Time of Victory
key_points.details: Dasha/Antardasha of 11th Lord or Lagna Lord with Pratyantar of 10th Lord or 11th house Nakshatra Lord. Transiting Jupiter aspecting Lagna, 6th, or 11th ensures victory.

key_points.name: Time of Defeat
key_points.details: Dasha of 6th or 12th Lord combined with Pratyantar of 8th Lord or a planet in the 12th house brings adverse results, especially if transit Saturn aspects the Lagna Lord from the 8th or 12th house.

key_points.name: Time of Compromise
key_points.details: Dasha of auspicious Jupiter or Mercury combined with Pratyantar of 7th Lord or Venus brings reconciliation or case withdrawal, supported by transiting Jupiter's aspect on the 6th or 7th house.
